meta.description: The chart's vocabulary. Stitch colours never follow dark mode: a chart is paper and ink. Finished stitches are cross-hatched in the app (this canvas can only show their flat tone).

do: Draw grids with 1px gray lines, a darker line every 10 stitches from the bottom-left, and a 2px black frame.
Highlight exactly one current stitch with a yellow ring.
Cross-hatch finished stitches over a dark (fill) or white (chain) base, so both stay readable.
dont: Invert the chart in dark mode.
Use red on the chart for anything but the active row marker.

StitchCell.description: One stitch on the chart. Fill is a full square, chain is an open square.

StitchRun.description: A run of identical stitches in a row's instructions: '9 fill'. Done runs fade, the active one is outlined.

count.description: How many in the run, e.g. 9.

ZoomControls.description: Zoom out, fit, zoom in. Sits bottom-right over every chart. Fit is active until the user zooms or pans.
